from functools import total_ordering


class CurrencyMismatch(ValueError):
    """Raised when an operation mixes two different currencies."""


@total_ordering
class Money:
    """An amount of money in a given currency."""

    def __init__(self, amount, currency="USD"):
        self.amount = amount
        self.currency = currency

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _coerce(self, other):
        """Return ``other`` if it is compatible ``Money`` else NotImplemented."""
        if not isinstance(other, Money):
            return NotImplemented
        if self.currency != other.currency:
            raise CurrencyMismatch(
                "cannot combine %r and %r" % (self.currency, other.currency)
            )
        return other

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # arithmetic
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def __add__(self, other):
        other = self._coerce(other)
        if other is NotImplemented:
            return NotImplemented
        return type(self)(self.amount + other.amount, self.currency)

    def __radd__(self, other):
        if other == 0:
            return self
        return self.__add__(other)

    def __sub__(self, other):
        other = self._coerce(other)
        if other is NotImplemented:
            return NotImplemented
        return type(self)(self.amount - other.amount, self.currency)

    def __rsub__(self, other):
        if other == 0:
            return -self
        result = self.__sub__(other)
        if result is NotImplemented:
            return NotImplemented
        return -result

    def __mul__(self, factor):
        if isinstance(factor, Money):

        return type(self)(self.amount * factor, self.currency)

    def __rmul__(self, factor):
        return self.__mul__(factor)

    def __truediv__(self, divisor):
        if isinstance(divisor, Money):
            divisor = self._coerce(divisor)
            if divisor is NotImplemented:
                return NotImplemented
            return self.amount / divisor.amount
        return type(self)(self.amount / divisor, self.currency)

    def __neg__(self):
        return type(self)(-self.amount, self.currency)

    def __abs__(self):
        return type(self)(abs(self.amount), self.currency)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # comparison
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if not isinstance(other, Money):
            return NotImplemented
        return (self.amount, self.currency) == (other.amount, other.currency)

    def __lt__(self, other):
        other = self._coerce(other)
        if other is NotImplemented:
            return NotImplemented
        return self.amount < other.amount

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((self.amount, self.currency))

    # representation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
